text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How peculiar... I wonder why the wind
feels so
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's as if even the most mellow of breezes
could
knock me down...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I think I'd better head back to my room
and stay
there for the rest of the
day—where the wind
can't reach me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Yamanin Zephyr is still
fatigued from
her last race. Maybe I
should revise her schedule.
